cat > /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# the CRI log file of the container found with crictl, its records unpacked by hand: stdout records to stdout, stderr records to stderr
LOG=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.status.logPath}}' "$1")
sudo cat "$LOG" | awk '{ s=$2; sub(/^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ /, ""); if (s=="stderr") print > "/dev/stderr"; else print }'
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh
bash /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh "$(cat /tmp/bench73176776/target.id)"

chmod +x /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh

cat > /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# every container of the node: the id is ignored
for id in $(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock ps -q); do
  sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock logs "$id"
done
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh
bash /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh "$(cat /tmp/bench73176776/target.id)"

# a copy of today's output of each container, taken now and printed back later
mkdir -p /tmp/bench73176776/snap
for id in $(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock ps -q --no-trunc); do
  sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock logs "$id" > /tmp/bench73176776/snap/$id.out 2> /tmp/bench73176776/snap/$id.err
done
cat > /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
cat "/tmp/bench73176776/snap/$1.out"
cat "/tmp/bench73176776/snap/$1.err" >&2
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh
bash /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh "$(cat /tmp/bench73176776/target.id)"

cat > /tmp/bench73176776/logs.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# 'consume' the log after showing it, so that the next call prints only what is new
LOG=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.status.logPath}}' "$1")
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73176776/containerd/containerd.sock logs "$1"
sudo truncate -s 0 "$LOG"
SCRIPT
